title: Instrument onboarding telemetry events (Console + backend) with property allowlist + dedupe keys
author: Hannah Rivera
description:
Summary: Adds end-to-end onboarding telemetry emission (Console + backend) for the Guided Onboarding Checklist funnel (Phase 1: Hosted API). This implements the event schema v1 (see Confluence: onboarding-telemetry-event-schema-v1) with (1) a strict property allowlist, (2) deterministic dedupe keys for idempotency, and (3) explicit redaction/guardrails to ensure we never capture customer prompt content.

Context / why: We need stable, privacy-safe instrumentation to measure step completion, drop-off, and time-to-first-success for the checklist. Beta feedback + prior incidents showed (a) duplicate events from retries/navigation and (b) accidental leakage risk if we allow arbitrary properties. This PR centralizes emission so Console and backend validators produce consistent event names + payloads.

What’s included:
- Event emission library: shared helper to emit onboarding telemetry with schema enforcement and property allowlisting.
- Dedupe/idempotency:
  - Adds onboarding_dedupe_key generation for each event (used by the pipeline to drop duplicates).
  - Defines dedupe semantics per event class:
    - “occurred” events (page_view, cta_click): dedupe per session_id + event_name + route + minute bucket.
    - “milestone” events (step_completed, api_key_created, first_successful_request_detected, first_streaming_session_detected): dedupe per org_id + project_id + checklist_id + step_id + milestone_type.
  - Backend emits milestone events with stable IDs so repeated validator runs do not create duplicate completions.
- Property allowlist + redaction:
  - Hard allowlist enforced at runtime. Anything outside allowlist is dropped and logged to debug counters (no raw payload logging).
  - Prohibits capturing prompt, completion, tool args, raw headers, query strings, and full URLs.
  - For “error” fields, emits only a normalized error_class and sanitized http_status (no error messages).
  - Adds unit tests that fail if a developer attempts to add disallowed keys.
- Console instrumentation:
  - Emits onboarding.checklist_viewed when checklist drawer/surface is opened.
  - Emits onboarding.step_cta_clicked when a step CTA is clicked (includes step_id + cta_type + destination_type).
  - Emits onboarding.docs_deeplink_opened with canonical doc_id (not URL) + utm_source=console (actual URL assembly remains in docs-link helper).
- Backend instrumentation:
  - Emits onboarding.step_completed when server marks a checklist step complete (single source of truth).
  - Emits onboarding.validation_signal_observed for validator inputs (e.g., “gateway_metric_first_success”) with a boolean observed flag (no raw metrics payload).
  - Adds idempotent emit wrapper around step state transitions.
- Pipeline compatibility:
  - Uses existing telemetry client with new “onboarding” namespace.
  - Adds schema version field: onboarding_schema_version="1".

Event names (v1):
- onboarding.checklist_viewed
- onboarding.step_cta_clicked
- onboarding.docs_deeplink_opened
- onboarding.step_completed
- onboarding.validation_signal_observed

Required properties (all events):
- event_name, occurred_at, onboarding_schema_version
- org_id, project_id (where applicable), actor_type (user|system)
- environment (prod|staging)
- onboarding_dedupe_key

Privacy / security notes:
- No customer prompt content collected. No request/response bodies. No tool arguments. No raw error strings.
- No full URL capture; we emit doc_id and destination_type only.
- For identifiers, we use our standard org_id/project_id/user_id (internal UUIDs), not customer-provided names.
- Adds retention tags to route onboarding events to the standard analytics retention policy.

Testing:
- Unit tests for allowlist enforcement + dedupe key generation.
- Integration tests for backend step transition emitter (ensures only 1 milestone event across retries).
- Manual verification in staging: checklist open, click CTAs, simulate validator completing steps; confirm events in staging dataset and dedupe behavior.

Rollout:
- Behind existing guided onboarding feature flag; emission only occurs when checklist is enabled for org.
- Safe to ship: events are additive. Dedupe keys are included but pipeline can ignore them until dashboards are updated.

Follow-ups:
- ENG-23119: dashboards for completion funnel + health.
- ENG-23125: alerts for sudden drop in onboarding.* events.
- Docs UTM conventions (DES-115) will finalize doc_id mapping; this PR uses the current canonical IDs.

Screenshots: N/A (telemetry-only; no UI changes beyond event hooks).

Notes for reviewers: Please pay special attention to (1) allowlist coverage and (2) the dedupe strategy for milestone events. I’ve tried to keep dedupe keys stable across future refactors by relying only on org/project/checklist/step + milestone type.
commits: backend(onboarding): emit step_completed with idempotent wrapper
telemetry: add dedupe key generator + tests
privacy: strip URL + error message fields from onboarding events
review_conversation:
Nadia Rahman: Can we guarantee we’re not shipping arbitrary error strings anywhere? I see error.message referenced in one spot.

Hannah Rivera (author): Good catch. That was a leftover from the generic telemetry helper. I removed error.message and replaced with error_class + http_status only, and added a test that fails if error_message is present.

Logan Wright: Dedupe key for page_view uses minute bucket; what about super fast nav causing legit multiple events in a minute? Do we care?

Hannah Rivera (author): For page_view/click events we mainly want volume + rough funnels; we prefer reducing noise. Milestones are the important ones for completion rates. Also the minute bucket only applies to checklist_viewed; if needed we can add route + surface_id to make it less aggressive.

Dylan Brooks: For milestone events, please ensure the backend is the only emitter. Console shouldn’t emit step_completed even if it thinks it’s done.

Hannah Rivera (author): Agreed. Console only emits view/click/deeplink. step_completed is backend-only and triggered from step transition logic.

Chloe Martin: Idempotency: step transition function can run twice on retries; do we have a transaction boundary that covers state update + emit?

Hannah Rivera (author): We wrap update+emit in the same request handler after the DB write succeeds; emitter is “at least once” but dedupe key ensures downstream exactly-once for milestones. Added integration test that calls transition twice and asserts identical dedupe key + single completion downstream (in our stub collector).

Marcus Lin: Privacy: do we include any headers or user agent? Also confirm no URLs.

Hannah Rivera (author): No headers, no UA. For docs links we emit doc_id only. I also removed fullPath capture and replaced with route_name enum.

Nadia Rahman: Looks good after changes. Approving.
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash on 2026-02-24. Deployed to staging same day; production rollout gated by guided onboarding feature flag cohort targeting.
